name: MUHIBAH
recent: Muhibbah Engineering 近期持续进行股份回购，并因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长63.2%，但净利同比下滑32.3%。
notable: 公司于2026年11月多次进行股份回购。
因员工认股权计划（ESOS）行使，公司于2026年9月及11月发行新股并上市。
risks: ESOS 新股发行导致股本逐步扩大，可能摊薄每股盈利。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 RM381.4 million，环比增长63.2%，同比增长16.5%；净利为 RM16.8 million，环比增长30.2%，但同比下滑32.3%；净利率为4.4%，低于上一季度的5.5%。

recent_en: Muhibbah Engineering has been actively buying back shares and issuing new shares from ESOS exercises. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 63.2% QoQ but net profit fell 32.3% YoY.
notable_en: The company conducted multiple share buybacks in November 2026.
New shares were issued and listed in September and November 2026 due to ESOS exercises.
risks_en: The issuance of new ESOS shares gradually enlarges the share base and may dilute earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM381.4 million, up 63.2% QoQ and 16.5% YoY; net profit was RM16.8 million, up 30.2% QoQ but down 32.3% YoY; net margin was 4.4%, lower than 5.5% in the previous quarter.
